model: Every individual belongs to one of the three exact listed body-mass classes;unknown class counts are nonnegative integers. Individual metabolic rate is m^0.75in a common normalized rate unit for min grams,and community rate is the SUMof individual rates. The observed total count and total mass are exact. No unknown class-specific coefficient or inter-individual interaction is allowed. Compare all feasible class allocations,not only a single assumed representative distribution.
target: Return the sharp interval of possible summed community metabolic rates,the rate obtained by incorrectly applying the individual allometry directly to the total500g biomass,and whether that latter value is a valid community aggregate under this model. Report whether count and total biomass identify the class distribution.
